items.difficulty_reason: 5 行陈述（5 行证明）、闭子概形构造三操作相容：F = 推前结构层特例归约 + chow 闭层等式引理缝合 + 模构造引理承担。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-family-associated-closed (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 754-758

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The closed subscheme construction is the module construction with F the pushforward of the structure sheaf of Z, the identification being the Chow Homology lemma relating the cycle of a closed subscheme to the cycle of its structure sheaf; the module construction's compatibility with the three operations then applies verbatim (source lines 760-764)
